items.name: Classic Pullover
items.flavor: Drawstrings, one pocket, no opinions.

items.name: Zip-Up
items.flavor: For when the office is exactly two degrees off.

items.name: Techwear
items.flavor: Straps that hold nothing. Reflective, though.

items.name: Night Cloak
items.flavor: Ships at 3am or not at all.

items.name: Basic Office
items.flavor: Adjusts in one axis. That axis is "no".

items.name: Racer
items.flavor: Bolstered wings. Zero laps completed.

items.name: Executive Leather
items.flavor: Tufted. Reclines further than the deadline.

items.name: Anti-Gravity
items.flavor: Floats. Physics pending review.

items.name: Stock Membrane
items.flavor: Came with the machine. Still here.

items.name: Mechanical
items.flavor: Audible from the next room. Intentionally.

items.name: Split Ergo
items.flavor: Two halves, one wrist, endless smugness.

items.name: Neon 60%
items.flavor: Fewer keys, more colours, same bugs.

items.name: Stock Mouse
items.flavor: Two buttons and a wheel. It works.

items.name: Gaming Mouse
items.flavor: Seven buttons. Two are bound.

items.name: Trackball
items.flavor: The wrist thanks you. The cursor does not.

items.name: Vertical Ergo
items.flavor: Held like a handshake with your desk.

items.name: Chipped Mug
items.flavor: The chip is load-bearing.

items.name: Thermos
items.flavor: Still hot at 4pm. Suspiciously.

items.name: Tea & Saucer
items.flavor: A saucer. On a developer's desk.

items.name: Energy Can
items.flavor: Tastes like a changelog.

items.name: Bare Desk
items.flavor: Minimalism, or forgetfulness.

items.name: Succulent
items.flavor: Survives neglect. Relatable.

items.name: Monstera
items.flavor: Big leaves. Bigger commitment.

items.name: Bonsai
items.flavor: Pruned more carefully than the git history.

items.name: Bare Wall
items.flavor: Ready for anything.

items.name: "Works On My Machine"
items.flavor: The oldest defence.

items.name: Shelf: Books & Trophy
items.flavor: Four books, one trophy, zero pages read.

items.name: Neon Sign
items.flavor: Casts a glow on every late commit.

items.name: No Buddy
items.flavor: Solo run.

items.name: Rubber Duck
items.flavor: Best listener on the team.

items.name: Desk Bot
items.flavor: Blinks. Judges. Blinks again.

items.name: Sleeping Cat
items.flavor: Has opinions about the keyboard. Asleep.
